nodes.name: 치이카와
nodes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: USER-REVIEW DRAFT of one 2.5D node head, NOT approved game production art. Input image 1 is the project's legacy portrait for identity; input image 2 is an OFFICIAL full-character identity reference. Draw ONLY the main character's HEAD (all ears, horns and attached head ornaments fully visible); ignore all body, props, text, neighboring characters and background from references. Preserve Nagano Chiikawa ORIGINAL facial drawing and silhouette proportions: sparse simple flat dark brown-black ink facial marks, tiny mouth and eyes exactly as reference; do not redesign as a generic stuffed animal. Medium: shallow 2.5D sculpted matte head with restrained soft volume and upper-left lighting, clean crisp dark outer outline, facial features remain mostly FLAT decals. Subtle depth on ears/head, no furry texture, no photoreal animal nose. Front orthographic view upright, single centered head, full silhouette within square frame with at least 8% padding, transparent alpha background. No background/floor/shadow outside silhouette, no title, text, labels, watermark, frame, body, shoulders, hands, tail, tools or food. Color and unique facial identifiers take priority over 3D realism. Subject: Chiikawa (ちいかわ). Very wide white rounded cheek silhouette, TWO tiny ROUND ears (NOT pointed), small shiny BLACK round eyes with tiny white glints well spaced in lower half of face, short delicate arched eyebrows, tiny minimalist w-shaped mouth with little chin dash, pink oval cheeks with THREE short diagonal dark hatch marks each. No projecting animal nose or muzzle.
nodes.review_focus: 작은 둥근 귀·흰 넓은 볼·작은 눈/입·분홍 빗금 볼
